changelog: Save a backup straight onto a USB drive plugged into your Vernis - no phone or computer needs to stay connected
Restore from a backup on a USB drive, in Settings or during setup, even without internet
USB drives are mounted automatically when you plug them in
Keep the IPFS store on an external drive; the move is checked and rolled back if anything goes wrong
Backups download as they are built, show real progress and can resume if interrupted
Restores no longer have a 500 MB limit and skip files you already have
Fix: backups missed art stored on an external drive, and restores dropped collections
Restored art is pinned to IPFS again automatically
New setup: pair your phone with the QR code or 6-digit code shown on the frame
Wallet import keeps the original media and asks for an OpenSea key when one is needed
Work Mode (optional): see your Claude plan usage on the frame
Startup screens are always the right way up, with no mouse pointer
Installing from a git clone works with 'bash install.sh', even when the IPFS download site is unreachable
